target: broadcast scene/time class of a shot (LIVE vs NOT_LIVE vs UNKNOWN); nothing per wrestler

features.F1_frac_ge2: fraction of the shot's sampled frames having >= 2 gated person boxes

hierarchy: if no sampled frame in the shot -> UNKNOWN (NO_FEATURES)
if replay_indicator == 1 -> REPLAY_SUSPECT (never reachable in V1.1)
p1_calculation: duration-weighted LIVE vs not-LIVE disagreement on reference-decidable duration; classifier UNKNOWN and REPLAY_SUSPECT count as not-LIVE; reference UNKNOWN excluded from numerator and denominator
